sources_tried: Seed file boise.json: worked. Of the maps results, SBI Contracting, D-10 Contracting and Midwest D-Vision were relevant. The rest were bathroom remodelers, glass shops, plumbers, stores and portable toilet rentals. Barrier Free Architecturals (Meridian) sells ADA showers and doesn't mention partitions. SCS Signs & Stripes and Specialty Construction Supply (Meridian) do striping and site supplies, not partitions. Interior Systems Inc's site is under construction and lists no services. Corporate Office Installations does office furniture only. Gatsby Glass does glass walls only.
sbicontractinginc.com: the www host returned 503; the bare domain worked
ASI, Bradley, Metpar, General Partitions, Ampco locators: not reached (no working locator URL found within the search budget)
The Blue Book: thebluebook.com search and iProView pages blocked (403). A web search found only a Boise portable-toilet listing.
BuildingConnected / Procore public profiles: not reached within the search cap

Web search (8 of 8 used): turned up mostly national online sellers. Partition Pros (NY phone, nationwide installer network), One Point Partitions (Boise delivery terminal only, says it doesn't install), Newton Distributing (Natick MA, 'installers on call' for Boise/Nampa) and Prestige Distribution were all excluded as national sellers with no local base.

Beacon (beaconcdl.com, South Salt Lake UT, 801-486-4884): supplies and installs Division 10 including bathroom partitions and says it serves Idaho. Excluded because it is about 340 miles away, beyond the 120-mile limit. It may still be worth adding as a regional prospect.
Cook & Boardman (cbxsolutions.com): 403 blocked, and no Idaho location confirmed
Yelp/BBB: no Boise partition-installer listings surfaced through search
CDH Idaho bathroom remodel bid Q&A PDF: no readable company names

candidates.name: SBI Contracting Inc (SBI Partitions & Accessories)
candidates.partition_evidence: Self-described Division 10 specialty construction company for commercial bathrooms; services page says it takes projects from design to completion including measuring and installation, and toilet partitions are a main product line; homepage testimonial mentions restroom stall work; about page cites expert installation and partition layout/ADA assistance.
red_flags: Major buy-around risk: stocks Hadrian partitions in a 12,000 sq ft Boise warehouse and resells Bobrick, Scranton and other brands
Installation is stated in general terms; no partition-specific project gallery seen
One MapQuest listing reportedly marks a business 'Closed' (not verified; website is active and updated Nov 2026)
candidates.reason: Boise-based Division 10 contractor that supplies and installs commercial restroom partitions in the Treasure Valley. Qualifies as an installer but is also a direct partitions distributor, so it competes with Next Partitions on supply.

license.name: SBI Contracting Inc (SBI Partitions & Accessories)
license.registry: Idaho DOPL contractor registration lookup (edopl.idaho.gov Online Services)
license.note: Not checked on the official record. The DOPL lookup is a script-driven portal (FAST/GenTax) that needs cookies and JavaScript, so it can't be searched automatically. Boise publishes no public list of Contractor Registration Declarations. The company site (https://sbicontractinginc.com/) gives Boise as its base and 208.376.5200 as its phone. It says it stocks toilet partitions and parts in a Boise warehouse that ship within 24 hours. The site shows no Idaho registration number. Search DOPL by hand.

candidates.name: D-10 Contracting Inc
candidates.partition_evidence: Division 10 specialties page offers bathroom partitions and bathroom accessories for commercial buildings (schools, offices, public facilities) along with installation by its installers.
red_flags: Site shows two different phone numbers: (208) 936-4475 on the quote link and (208) 936-4775 in the footer
No project photos or brands named
Also does window coverings and patio shades; it supplies the products it installs
candidates.reason: Meridian Division 10 contractor whose site lists commercial bathroom partitions with installation. No project photos seen, but its services clearly include partition supply and install.

license.name: D-10 Contracting Inc
license.registry: Idaho DOPL contractor registration lookup (edopl.idaho.gov Online Services)

candidates.name: Midwest D-Vision Solutions (MWDS)
candidates.partition_evidence: Products list includes toilet compartments/partitions and washroom accessories; projects page shows three projects tagged 'Bathroom Partitions, Tile, Accessories' (Instructure, Corporate Office, Chevron) but doesn't say whether it installed them.
red_flags: Projects page refers to the 'local Utah general contracting and architectural community' and lists Utah-type clients, so the project list may be copied from another company's site
No statement that it installs rather than supplies
Architectural products supplier, so it sells partitions itself
candidates.reason: Boise architectural products company listing toilet partitions and some partition projects, but installation isn't confirmed and the project list looks borrowed from a Utah template.

license.name: Midwest D-Vision Solutions (MWDS)
license.registry: Idaho DOPL contractor registration lookup (edopl.idaho.gov Online Services)
license.note: Not checked on the official record. The DOPL lookup needs cookies and JavaScript, so it can't be searched automatically. The company site (https://www.mwdsidaho.com/) gives Boise as its base and 208.505.6333 as its phone, and lists toilet compartments/partitions and operable panel partitions. The site shows no Idaho registration number. A third-party site (ccblookup.com, https://www.ccblookup.com/contractor/midwest-d-vision-solutions-boise-232118/) appears in search results as listing an Oregon CCB license, number 232118 going by its URL. That page was not opened and is not the official Oregon CCB record. It is not an Idaho registration in any case. Search DOPL by hand.
